title: 食蜂操祈 · 深夜宿舍的甜品共犯·「这是本小姐与你的秘密♪」
description: 熄灯后的常盘台宿舍里，食蜂穿不透的浅蓝丝绸长睡袍，腰带系好，盘腿坐在地毯上。矮桌摆着一块草莓奶油蛋糕和两只小碟，她拿起一把干净的甜点叉向前递出，另一手轻扶桌沿。金色长发垂在肩侧，星形瞳孔映着台灯的暖光，她弯起眼睛，示意这份夜宵要悄悄分享。
action: 系好长睡袍盘坐地毯，一手递出甜点叉，另一手扶矮桌边，含笑邀请分享蛋糕。
camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
promptProse: A clean dessert fork is offered across a low table by Misaki Shokuhou from A Certain Scientific Railgun. Sitting cross-legged on the dorm carpet, she wears an opaque pale-blue silk robe with long sleeves, its front closed and sash tied over pajamas. Her other hand rests on the table beside strawberry cake and two plates. Long blonde hair frames yellow-brown star-pupiled eyes and a conspiratorial smile. A shaded desk light illuminates this quiet late snack. One girl, no writing.

title: 希耶尔 · 纯白圣堂的赎罪婚誓
description: 日光从教堂彩窗落到圣坛前，希耶尔换上有完整内衬的纯白露肩长婚纱，白色头纱落在齐颌蓝发旁。她摘下眼镜，双手在心口前合握一枚银十字架，微微抬起眼睛，深蓝眼眸里蓄着克制的泪光。婚纱裙摆铺落石阶，窗上的蓝白色光斑映亮她逐渐放松的笑容。
location: 洒满神圣彩窗光晕的宏伟教堂十字架圣坛前
action: 站在圣坛前，双手合握心口银十字架，摘下眼镜抬眼露出含泪的浅笑。
camera: medium shot, eye level, altar portrait
promptProse: Before the chapel altar, Ciel from Tsukihime clasps a small silver cross with both hands at her heart. Her opaque white bridal gown has an off-shoulder neckline and a long skirt resting across the stone step. A veil falls beside her chin-length navy-blue hair; without glasses, her sapphire eyes lift through restrained tears toward a quiet smile. Blue-white stained-glass patches brighten the fabric and her face. Keep the cross, hands and upper skirt clearly visible in a solitary bridal portrait.
